title: Alua
name: alua
short_description: Autonomous companion with follow, memory, recall and sensor commands.
long_description:
Alua is an experimental autonomous companion framework for Luanti, currently tested with Mineclonia.

Current playable features:
- persistent owner-bound companion entity
- autonomous follow behaviour
- stay/follow switching by command or right-click
- recall to the owner
- simple persistent memory of the owner's last seen position
- local sensor report and status command
- one active companion per player

Commands: /alua_spawn, /alua_follow, /alua_stay, /alua_recall, /alua_status, /alua_scan, /alua_remove, /alua_help.

The project is Work in Progress. Future stages will add richer perception, path planning, goals, inventories and an optional external AI bridge.
